title: BRS, Congress workers clash during biryani protest targeting Rahul Gandhi

ai.summary: BRS and Congress workers clashed at a biryani protest in Hyderabad targeting Rahul Gandhi over employment promises, with police intervening to prevent escalation.

facts.claim: BRS leaders staged an unusual biryani protest at Hyderabad's Bavarchi restaurant on November 26, targeting Congress leader Rahul Gandhi over the alleged failure to fulfil the Congress-led Telangana government's promise of providing two lakh jobs to unemployed youth.
facts.quote: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) leaders staged an unusual biryani protest at Hyderabad's Bavarchi restaurant on November 26, targeting Congress leader Rahul Gandhi over the alleged failure to fulfil the Congress-led Telangana government's promise of providing two lakh jobs to unemployed youth.

facts.claim: The demonstration soon took a confrontational turn after Congress workers arrived at the restaurant. Heated arguments broke out between the two groups, escalating into a clash in which plates were allegedly thrown at each other.
facts.quote: The demonstration soon took a confrontational turn after Congress workers arrived at the restaurant. Heated arguments broke out between the two groups, escalating into a clash in which plates were allegedly thrown at each other.

facts.claim: Police personnel intervened and brought the situation under control, preventing the confrontation from escalating further.
facts.quote: Police personnel intervened and brought the situation under control, preventing the confrontation from escalating further.

facts.claim: Congress Rajya Sabha MP Anil Kumar Yadav criticised the BRS leaders for choosing such a mode of protest.
facts.quote: Congress Rajya Sabha MP Anil Kumar Yadav criticised the BRS leaders for choosing such a mode of protest.

facts.claim: The latest confrontation comes a week after another clash between Congress and BRS workers at a pension distribution programme in Hyderabad's LB Nagar constituency on November 19.
facts.quote: The latest confrontation comes a week after another clash between Congress and BRS workers at a pension distribution programme in Hyderabad's LB Nagar constituency on November 19.

ai.background_note: BRS and Congress have had prior clashes over employment promises and access to government programs in Hyderabad.
